title: Polvo de colores · el ánima de Luca en el motor
description: The coloured powder of Luca's ánima, the powder thrown at a Holi, in the effects lab over the fight with the chaplains in Fran's salon (?fxlab, src/powder-fx.ts, src/powder-lab.ts; docs/animas/prismatico/README.md § Look and interface). Dry pigment, matte (the `powder` shape, src/fight-particles.ts), in muted colours that every puff mixes; it bursts, hangs and gets on everything. Fire on it explodes and burns everyone, water on it runs green (the `pool` shape) and poisons, and a screen of it stands in front of an ally until a blow breaks it. Only the look, never a fight's numbers. Run it with --gpu --scale 2.

steps.caption: The puff alone: the powder bursts, stops in the air within half a metre and hangs; jets stretch into plumes, grains fly on, drift down and stay on the floor. Matte: it takes the scene's light and has none of its own
A sixth of a second in: the core has already stopped, the jets and the grains are still flying
A second and a half later: a thin cloud still hanging, and powder on the floor
A handful thrown: it crosses in a third of a second leaving a streak in the air, bursts on the foe and leaves it covered in powder
Covered in powder: it clings to the foe's parts and sheds grains, with a little of the cloud still round it
One handful for every foe, a breath apart, each its own mix of the palette
All three covered, the clouds mixing, the floor dusted

Fire on the powder: it explodes. A flash and a ball of flame off each covered foe, the powder blown out charred, a ring along the floor, embers thrown at whoever stands near, and all of them left burning a little
After it: scorched floor, smoke, and every foe burning at level I
Water on the powder: it darkens and runs, turning green as it goes; it drips, pools at their feet, and poisons them
After it: the powder run wet on them and on the floor, and every foe poisoned
The cortina, the protective spell: a handful thrown upwards hangs in front of an ally as a standing screen, grains falling from it
Standing: a body wide and a little taller, between the ally and the foes, until a blow breaks it
The blow that breaks it: the whole screen is thrown forward over whoever dealt it, who is left covered in powder (Rebufo)
Telón: a cortina in front of each ally
Both standing
Rociada: a fan of fine water from the wearer that falls over every foe and breaks into mist; the powder on them runs green
Traca: five small puffs on foes picked at random, a breath apart, each in its own mix; whoever was hit is left covered
Fin de fiesta, the definitiva: the dust explosion. The bags torn open, one matte cloud over the foes, a front of fire through it, a heavy green rain, an arc from foe to foe and the crystal spikes
The first round: the same handful in grey
